o1.biggest_strength: It uses Plausible's own data well, especially the trial-rate gap between comparison pages and blog posts, and turns that into a capacity-aware 12-page plan.
o1.biggest_mistake: The forecast is a bit aggressive, and the first week starts with the GA comparison instead of the cheaper cookie-banner and cookie-free page wins the brief hints are urgent.

o2.what_would_make_it_a_10: Add the docs/internal-link work, pull the cookie-banner and cookie-free fixes into week one, and reduce the broad 140-post tagging work to a smaller high-impression audit.

reason: I would rather hand Output 2 to the team because the forecasts are more believable and the ordering is a little cleaner. Output 1 has some good extra ideas, especially around docs, but it overstates upside and crowds the dev work more.
